# JupiterResource

> Domain research archive for Jupiter. Literature reviews and primary-source analyses. Curated by Corgan Studio, Inc.

Research Archive: https://jupiterresource.net/research/ (literature reviews by Corgan Studio, Inc., open to read).

## Research Archive

- [Galilean moon tidal heating budgets: from Peale 1979 to Galileo and Juno](https://jupiterresource.net/research/galilean-tidal-heating): Review of the tidal-heating energy budgets for Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto, from the prediction of Io's volcanism to the present-day constraints from Galileo and Juno mass-loss and gravity-field measurements.
- [Great Red Spot size evolution and convective dynamics](https://jupiterresource.net/research/great-red-spot-evolution): Review of the Great Red Spot's measured size evolution from 1879 to 2026, the recent acceleration of shrinkage observed since 2012, the Juno deep-structure constraints, and the convective and barotropic-instability mechanisms proposed for the storm's persistence and current decline.
- [Jovian magnetospheric structure and the Io plasma torus](https://jupiterresource.net/research/jovian-magnetosphere-io-plasma-torus): Review of Jupiter's magnetospheric architecture, with focus on the Io plasma torus as the dominant internal mass source, current-sheet dynamics, and Juno-era constraints on auroral processes.
- [JUICE and Europa Clipper: target observation plans for Jovian icy moons](https://jupiterresource.net/research/juice-europa-clipper): Review of the science objectives and target-observation plans for ESA's JUICE (Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer) and NASA's Europa Clipper missions, the Ganymede vs Europa-vs-Callisto observational priorities, and the cross-mission coordination for shared Jovian-system science.
- [Juno deep atmospheric microwave probing of Jupiter](https://jupiterresource.net/research/juno-microwave-atmosphere): Review of the Juno Microwave Radiometer (MWR) results on Jupiter's deep atmosphere, the implications for ammonia abundance and meridional structure, the deep-water-cloud absent-detection result, and the constraints on dynamics below the visible cloud deck.
